items.author: dhampirvampire.bsky.social
items.context:
Fun Fact: Did you guys know that the very first PC game I ever bought with my own money was Dragon Age: Origins Ultimate Edition? Also the very last game I was ever able to find a PHYSICAL copy for PC was Dragon Age II?
image: Photo of the covers for PC versions of Dragon Age Origins Ultimate Edition and Dragon Age II
items.text: A solid first purchase. The Ultimate Edition packs the expansions in with the main game, so that was a lot of Dragon Age for one buy. Funny how rare physical PC copies have become.
items.verify: Проверь: Dragon Age: Origins Ultimate Edition включает дополнения.

items.author: eyesack.bsky.social
items.context: Does anyone else remember a very basic roller coaster designer game from the MS-DOS era? I think there were only two height levels, low poly 3d graphics, first person ridethrough. I played the heck out of it on a school computer
items.text: Can't place that one, but it sounds like a great school-computer memory. Anything you recall about the title screen or the ride camera helps narrow down old DOS games.
